descricion: The game randomly selects several images depending on the number of dice you choose.
The participant must tell a story to the other person by connecting all the images that appeared.
dados-historiosos.resumo: Tell a story by connecting the random images rolled on the dice.

dificultades.facil: Ideal to start and get familiar with the game dynamics.
dificultades.media: A balanced challenge to put your skills to the test.
dificultades.dificil: A greater challenge for those looking to test their limits.

descricion: The game host reads a word that the teams must guess.
If a team knows the answer, they can say it. If they don't know it, they can say «Pass the Word» to pass the turn.
pasa-palabra.resumo: Guess the words or say «Pass the Word» to pass the turn.

descricion: Starting from an initial letter shown on the screen, each participant must say a word that begins with the same letter the previous word ended with.
palabras-encadeadas.resumo: Chain words starting from the last letter of the previous word.

descricion: The application gives orders and actions based on body movements, gestures, or displacements that the participants must execute.
The orders can include individual actions or sequences of multiple movements.
simon-di.resumo: Perform body movements and actions guided by the application.

descricion: The application proposes a theme related to the past, such as old toys, school, or professions.

Older adults share experiences and memories of what life was like in their time, while younger ones listen, ask questions, and compare those experiences with the present, creating a dialogue between generations.

elementos: Street play and our old toys

baul-recordos.resumo: Share past experiences and dialogue between generations on different topics.
